name: fde
description: Forward Deployed Engineering field kit: a router skill that classifies each engagement on six axes, 25 artifact templates, a value ledger with evidence-based acceptance, meeting debriefs, assumption tests, blast-radius and rollback checks, prototype capture, guided-tour builder and FSPARK feedback tours (Feedback-based Spotlight Presentation, Assessment, Response & Knowledge), ROI and use-case scoring, engagement state with gate calendar, STE linting, and reviewer and research agents.
